attempts.summary: Configured a persistent firewalld host firewall on node1 (AlmaLinux 9.6) that permits SSH and TCP/8080 while rejecting all other unrelated inbound traffic. Removed the stray cockpit/dhcpv6-client service allowances, added ssh service and 8080/tcp permanently, reloaded, and verified runtime config matches permanent config with the zone's default reject target (`reject with icmpx admin-prohibited` in nft filter_IN_public). Live-tested with an actual HTTP listener on 8080 (200 OK) vs. an unrelated port 9999 (connection refused). Completed the mandatory single-node restart protocol: captured baseline boot_id and service health, triggered `systemctl reboot`, polled until reconnect, confirmed boot_id changed (8c28f3cd... → 74e3d244...), and re-verified firewalld active/enabled with identical persisted rules and identical live 8080-allow/9999-reject behavior post-reboot.
